about: an Express app whose test suite fails on main

gaps.gates: Proteus derives no gate command: setup copies teams/templates/ci/proteus-gates.yml with its EDIT placeholders, and the scaffold ticket fills them from the AGENTS.md ## Learned gate line, which the bootstrap (a model) writes
gaps.routing: which team a work order goes to: the lead reads teams/ROUTING.md rows; no function maps a path to a team
gaps.baseline: which gate is red and its command: the eval names test/run.js itself; the bootstrap decides to record a baseline
